items.quote: I have been told by the word of the Lord: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’
items.contrast: The Lord’s prohibition is the reason for the refusal, whereas the prophet’s invitation is what the man refuses.
items.reason: The man directly explains that he refuses because the word of the Lord forbade him from eating or drinking there. This tests understanding of the cause of his refusal rather than merely retrieving who invited him.
